flows: Change -> recorder session token -> serialized native start -> DOM/native key -> draft -> explicit Save -> field-only settings patch.
Patch worker -> serialized settings write -> shared registration owner -> acquire candidate -> SQLite save -> release old key -> publish status/settings -> current keycaps.
Registration/duplicate/parse failure -> per-action Conflict -> old mapping/settings retained -> editable candidate/retry.
Window blur -> ordered pause -> focus -> reacquire -> enable/focus input; cancel/unmount -> token-matched cleanup.
Startup -> validate every action -> skip unavailable key only -> truthful per-action native status; restart restores custom and disabled fields.
scope: Owned browser/app/WebView/data fixtures and DOM input only. Production shortcut transaction, native settings commands, injected conflicts/recorder focus, route mapping, current asset embedding and restart. No real global key registration/input, clipboard/cursor, user files/accounts/profiles, shell/autostart/notification registration, installer/signing or OS settings. Actual other-app key ownership and other platforms/hardware are not claimed.
